steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each final term is matched to the last offer. A term that changed with no record is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 final term changed with no record

findings.title: Final term differs from the last offer with no record
findings.fix: Record the change and who agreed it

findings.title: Concession with no recorded return
findings.fix: Record what was asked in return

findings.title: Lesson with no source
findings.fix: Name the negotiation it came from

outcome.notChecked: What the counterparty privately thought, and outcomes after the close.
